meta.title: TDS Computation & Section Mapping: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify whether TDS Computation & Section Mapping is refused or absent.
Use TDS Computation & Section Mapping to compute TDS against the correct section.
Repeat the same action as an AP Executive and compare availability and outcome on the same tenant.
Verify or record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the AP Executive role and verify whether TDS Computation & Section Mapping is refused or absent.; Use TDS Computation & Section Mapping to compute TDS against the correct section.; Repeat the same action as an AP Executive and compare availability and outcome on the same tenant.; Verify or record whether tenant RBAC deliberately grants the action to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as a non-AP Executive user and then an AP Executive on the same Enterprise tenant, perform TDS Computation & Section Mapping to compute TDS against the correct section, and compare whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot sign in as these buyer personas or operate the TDS Computation & Section Mapping feature.
